plan: Deep-copy and validate the workspace tree, indexing unique item IDs during traversal.
Use recursive traversal for word counts, unresolved markers, outlines, and containment checks.
Validate every move completely before mutating lists, ensuring failed moves are atomic.
Return deep copies from to_data() so callers cannot mutate internal state.
mechanisms: Regular expressions for marker extraction and word counting

trace.source_relation: Workspace data is deep-copied, and to_data() returns a deep copy.
Notes use regex-defined words while marker syntax and identifiers do not count.
Unresolved identifiers come from note marker tokens and reference unresolved lists.
trace.target_mechanism: Recursive collection into a set followed by lexicographic sorting

trace.source_relation: Failed moves must leave the workspace exactly unchanged.
trace.target_mechanism: All source, destination, index, and containment checks occur before list mutation

trace.source_relation: Containers cannot be moved into themselves or their descendants.
trace.target_mechanism: Recursive descendant traversal with identity comparison
